race.name: Myconid Hybrid
entries: Somewhere in the Underdark, creatures born from the parasitic relationship between fungi and some poor fool that got lost in the tunnels and caves which constitutes this maze-like nightmare, roam in the dark, seeking for flesh to consume and appease their hunger.

entries.name: Mycelial Flesh
entries: Part of your body is not your body anymore; with each passing day, the fungi claims more of your flesh and is slowly killing you.

You have a counter that represents the growth status of the fungi. It starts at 5. Each time you don’t meet the minimum food requirements in a day, roll {@dice 1d4}; subtract the result from your maximum hit points and add it to your Fungal counter.

Additionally, for each 3 lbs of food you eat, you can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, roll {@dice 1d4}, subtract the result from your Fungal counter, and add it to your maximum hit points. Your Fungal counter cannot be reduced below 5.
If your maximum hit points are reduced to 0 in this way, you lose control of your character, and it transforms into a {@creature Myconid Adult|MM} zombie.

entries.name: Infectious Spores
entries: Thanks to your new body roommate, you have gained new abilities that allow you to do things you couldn’t before in exchange for a small part of yourself.

You have a number of Spore Charges equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended charges when you finish a Long Rest. When you expend a Spore Charge, roll {@dice 1d4} and subtract the result from your maximum hit points. You then gain temporary hit points equal to half your Fungal counter + the result of the die roll.
You can use your Spore Charges to power the following abilities. You can spend additional charges when activating an ability to amplify its effects:

items: {@bold Telepathic Spores:} As a Bonus Action, you can establish telepathic communication with any number of creatures and plants within a 20-foot range emanation for 10 minutes. {@bold Amplify:} You can spend additional charges, adding 20 feet to the range for each extra charge spent.

{@bold Spore Echolocation:} As a Bonus Action, you spread spores in a 10-foot radius emanation centered on you. For 1 minute, you gain Blindsight within that range. {@bold Amplify:} You can spend additional charges, adding 5 feet to the range for each extra charge spent.

{@bold Cordycepian Spores:} When you are attacked by a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction and spend a charge to force every creature within 5 feet of you to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 13). On a failure, a target takes {@damage 1d6} poison damage. Starting at 5th level, if a creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is {@condition charmed|XPHB} until the end of its next turn. {@bold Amplify:} You can spend additional charges, adding +2 to the DC for each extra charge spent.

entries.name: Another Conscience
entries: When you fall {@condition unconscious|XPHB}, your body has the ability to keep moving without your conscious control.
